stages.name: setup
stages.description: download Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (bf16) and LiveCodeBench release_latest

steps.name: models
steps.cmd: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; [print(s(m, allow_patterns=['*.json','*.safetensors','tokenizer*','*.model','*.txt'])) for m in ('unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct', 'Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct')]"

steps.name: livecodebench
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=0 python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src/benchmark_repo/LiveCodeBench'); from lcb_runner.benchmarks.code_generation import load_code_generation_dataset as L; print(len(L('release_latest', start_date='2025-01-01', end_date='2025-05-01')))" | tee {RESULTS}/setup/lcb_count.txt

stages.name: main_qwen
stages.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct (vLLM, bf16): Base, TextGrad, ExeCRE on LiveCodeBench 2025-01..05, n=5 runs (authors' configs)

steps.name: run
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && python {HPC}/glue_execre.py {method} qwen32b {RESULTS}/cfg/qwen32b_{method}.json {SMOKEFLAG} && ONLINE_BASE_URL=$OPENAI_BASE_URL ONLINE_API_KEY=local HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 python main.py --config {RESULTS}/cfg/qwen32b_{method}.json

steps.name: score
steps.cmd: mkdir -p {RESULTS}/scores && cd {REPO} && HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 python -m src.experiments.solution_chain --config_file {RESULTS}/cfg/qwen32b_{method}.json --skip_generate --skip_evaluate 2>&1 | tee {RESULTS}/scores/qwen32b_{method}.txt

steps.name: run
steps.cmd: cd {REPO} && python {HPC}/glue_execre.py {method} llama8b {RESULTS}/cfg/llama8b_{method}.json {SMOKEFLAG} && ONLINE_BASE_URL=$OPENAI_BASE_URL ONLINE_API_KEY=local HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 python main.py --config {RESULTS}/cfg/llama8b_{method}.json

steps.name: score
steps.cmd: mkdir -p {RESULTS}/scores && cd {REPO} && HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 python -m src.experiments.solution_chain --config_file {RESULTS}/cfg/llama8b_{method}.json --skip_generate --skip_evaluate 2>&1 | tee {RESULTS}/scores/llama8b_{method}.txt
